featured_reviews.name: Ashok Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently got Dali Oberon on wall speakers from AV Squad.
It was an amazing experience.This experience needs a mention, so i'm writing this review so that the right attitude and approach
gets the due appreciation.

It all started with a referral from my friend, who connected me to AV squad. He recently purchased an integrated amplifier, floor standing speakers and a sub woofer.

Jignesh is a fantastic person. He understood what I was looking in depth, probing all different aspects of the requirement, spending an hour with me over phone and then suggesting Dali Oberon on wall.
The speakers are mind blowing, crystal clear sound, decent base, amazing looks. These are one of those instances in your live where you get what EXACTLY you were looking for. Super thanks to Jignesh and Dali for giving me this joy of enjoying music the way i ever desired.

Overall I'm super satisfied by the experience. I remember what Jignesh said to me once, its not about selling boxes rather than creating wonderful experiences. :)

featured_reviews.name: Manish Kumawat
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently stumbled upon AV Squad Mumbai while shopping for audio equipment on Amazon, and the experience that followed was absolutely fantastic.

Firstly, their team went above and beyond to address all my queries, ensuring that I made an informed decision about the Denon PMA-900HNE amplifier and Polk R200 speaker. Their knowledge and responsiveness were a breath of fresh air in the world of online shopping.

Not only did AV Squad Mumbai offer a competitive price, but they also delivered on time and with meticulous packaging. This attention to detail showcased their commitment to customer satisfaction.

Overall, I am thrilled with my purchase from AV Squad Mumbai. Their presence on Amazon, exceptional customer support, competitive pricing, and punctual delivery made this transaction a breeze. I wholeheartedly recommend them for anyone in search of top-notch audio gear

featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Vora
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are two main reasons for the 5 stars.

In an industry where there are multiple product options, each more confusing than the other, compounded with the fact that the consumer, not too familiar with the technical aspects and always wanting the latest models, it’s very easy for the dealer/supplier of hi fi audio/video systems to take advantage of the unsuspecting buyer and upsale their products. Moreover, quite often, after giving a glib talk, we are prodded to buy products that are not even required in the hi fi set up. In other words, most, if not all, dealer/suppliers take advantage of the unsuspecting buyer.

Secondly, speaking generally for the overall Indian industry, and more particularly for the ever growing hi fi audi/video industry, after sales service has always been an issue. Raat gayee, baat gayee is the attitude consumers usually have to deal with.

On both of the above points AV Squad is an exception. Jignesh Bhai not only dissuaded me from buying an amp but also didn’t chase me for selling the floor standing speakers that I was planning to buy from him. More importantly, even after realising that due to personal reasons I am not going to make any further purchases from him, his response time and technical support for the products that he had sold, remained the same; prompt and professional.

Trust, transparency and technical expertise, one will find all the three and more at AV Squad. I strongly recommend them to those looking for AV products.

featured_reviews.name: Chandi R
featured_reviews.review_text: I have purchased polk t50 tower speakers from. Amazon and the experience is extremely positive. The packing is very well done and the speakers are delivered well ahead of time. The seller is very supportive and responds to your queries patiently.

featured_reviews.name: ajith krishna
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jignesh does an amazing job of being patient and thorough about your AV needs, provides an honest recommendation for what is good and what isn't.

He is almost always accessible, day or night and ensures your queries are addressed within a reasonable time. The pricing he offers is also very competitive and is generally priced lower than what's available with other vendors.

For now, I have purchased a pair of Yamaha NS-F160 Speakers with the Yamaha RX-V4A receiver and am in awe of the 2-channel setup. If I decide to add more color to my music, I will surely go back to Jignesh for some surround recommendations.

The only feedback I would give is about the shipping/delivery timelines - Although this is not in his direct control, he can partner with an agency which has committed timelines and assured deliveries.

featured_reviews.name: M John
featured_reviews.review_text: I bought a Cambridge audio Minx X201 sub from AV Squad. The price was very competitive. The item was very well packed & reached with no damage. I set up the sub without problems. It is an excellent match with my Elac debut 5.2 speakers. All through the process Mr Jignesh was very helpful. It was a very good buying experience.
